# Damage-Taken Reduction Pooling — Distinct Sources Multiply

- **Status:** ✅ Confirmed
- **Mechanic tags:** damage-pool, defensive, stacking, methodology
- **Last verified:** 2026-09-07 by Tyra

## Setup

Surfaced by a reported build (share code 1FrxGVV) stacking six independent damage-taken-reduction sources on the same defensive pool: a conditional belt affix (-16% at Low Mana), an Onslaughter talent node (-6%), three Blessing-stack conditions (Focus -16%, Agility -16%, Tenacity -20%), and a Resurrection Warcry line scaled by Warcry Power (-47.42%). General mechanic, not specific to any one skill — Resurrection Warcry is just the triggering case here.

## Raw data points

No fresh in-game meter/screenshot reading was taken for this exact six-source stack — this is an OWNER STATEMENT extending an already-empirically-confirmed pattern, not a new independent measurement (see additional-speed-pooling.json: in-game 2.02/s = ×1.10×1.225, not the additive ×1.325; support-additional-damage-pooling.json: two +20% universal additional lines measured at ×1.44, not ×1.40). The owner directly confirmed the SAME multiplicative-pooling mechanic applies to damage-taken-reduction sources. Worked arithmetic for the reported six sources: 0.84 × 0.94 × 0.84 × 0.84 × 0.80 × 0.5258 ≈ 0.2344 (damage taken reduced to ~23.4% of raw, ~76.6% total reduction) — vs. the old flat-sum result of 1 + (-1.2142) = -0.2142 (nonsensical negative/over-immune), which is what actually exposed the bug.

## Derived / confirmed formula

`net_multiplier = Π(1 + amount_i)` over every DISTINCT contributing source to the pooled damage-taken-reduction keys (per damage-type/delivery combination), clamped per-source at 0 (a single source can legitimately reach exactly 0 = immunity) but the product of several sub-100% sources can only asymptotically approach, never reach, zero. Mirrors the existing `derive._additional_pool_factor` pattern already used for Max Life/Mana/ES/Armor/Evasion/Barrier Shield.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Scoped to player/friendly-unit defensive stats only. `enemy_nearby_dmg_taken_additional` (offense-side enemy-vulnerability amplification, used in `offense.py`) is explicitly excluded — owner-confirmed that's a different mechanic with no immunity concept and routinely exceeds 100% in normal play. `trauma_dmg_taken_inc` / `crit_dmg_taken_reduction` are declared but not consumed anywhere in the engine yet; left on the old per-stat guard check as a placeholder, not migrated to this pooling (nothing live to fix there). A single source alone reaching >=100% still raises `ImmunityThresholdError` (owner-confirmed: true single-source immunity isn't a thing this engine should silently allow).

## Implementation (engine model)

`backend/engine/defense.py::_dmg_taken_factor` (+ new `_dmg_taken_keys` grouping helper) — replaced a flat sum across `dmg_taken_additional` / `physical_dmg_taken_additional` / `elemental_dmg_taken_additional` / `hit_dmg_taken_additional` / `dot_dmg_taken_additional` with `derive._additional_pool_factor`. `backend/engine/guards.py::check_damage_taken_immunity` rewritten to check the same grouped key-sets for a SINGLE source alone reaching immunity (raises `ImmunityThresholdError`), since multiplying several distinct sub-100% sources can no longer produce a false immunity reading — that was the root cause of the 1FrxGVV bug.
